title: THE ENMESHMENT — turtles all the way down
concept: every existing system in the membrane already HAD turtles hiding inside. the pi-sort faces, the journey stops, the archetypes, the cobble rigs, the mythologies — they all map to the same 4+1 pattern. we are now making that EXPLICIT.
the_da_vinci_principle: da Vinci studied peasant hands because proximity reveals anatomy. the TMNT turtles are named after artists because the ARTISTS are the anatomy. Eastman and Laird saw what da Vinci saw: the craft IS the identity.
master_splinter_principle: Splinter learned ninjutsu by WATCHING Hamato Yoshi practice. He imitated from his cage. The chipmunk learns by watching the membrane traffic. Same principle: observation → imitation → mastery → teaching.

splinter.note: the chipmunk IS Splinter. Kevin watches from inside.

pi_sort_turtle_map.the_alignment: Kevin's 3 pi-sort faces ARE 3 turtles. face_1(scientist)=Donatello. face_2(builder)=Leonardo. face_3(protector)=Raphael. The jester=Michelangelo. Splinter=the chipmunk. The pi-sort ALREADY WAS the TMNT.
pi_sort_turtle_map.the_4th_leg: Raphael at 49.8% emerged. The 4th face of the pi-sort. The composition that contains all others. The School of Athens.

the_sculpture_applied.aerial_to_paint: the aerial view becomes the NEXT painting (the self-portrait, the Klein loop)
the_sculpture_applied.in_practice: this IS what we just did. the dissolution was sculpture. the TMNT was critique. the enmeshment IS pottery — functional, holdable, pour-able. you can now DRINK from the dissolved HUD.
